messages:
lisa: FYI escalation from Acme EU — their AP team refuses invoices because our PDF omits the legal entity VAT/registration block and the buyer PO number on the top of the invoice. Customer sent a sample: https://redwood-invoices.internal/snap/INV-98765.pdf

raj: Oof. They flagged this in writing: needs VAT reg no, full registered address, and PO printed in header (not just footnote). Also line-items must include the VAT rate per line (they do per-line tax reporting).

kevin: Do we have a repro? Which code path produced that PDF?

lisa: Support repro steps I got from them: 1) Create billing profile with company_short_name set, 2) issue invoice via POST /v1/invoices/generate with payload including billing_account. They provided minimal payload. I attached their payload JSON in the ticket.

support-jen: I reproduced locally — generator v2 (html->pdf) collapses the legal_entity block when company_short_name exists. Looks like the template conditional checks only for legal_entity.address_lines and not for legal_entity.vat_number. If address_lines empty, it hides whole block.

kevin: That template change was introduced in 2025-11 patch to reduce space on small invoices. We probably inverted the conditional. Quick patch: change the header conditional to show if any of (legal_entity.name, legal_entity.vat_number, legal_entity.registration_number, billing_account.po_number) exist.

raj: Confirmed. This client requires PO on header, not footer. Also they require line-item tax breakdown. Our current line-item table only has total_tax column when invoice-level tax present. Need per-line tax_rate and tax_amount columns.

eric: Is this going to be a breaking change for US customers? We should make it opt-in via invoice template config per customer (billing_account.template_version) and default to backwards-compatible layout.

kevin: For speed, I can ship a hotfix that restores the legal entity block unconditionally for EU-taxed accounts and adds PO header if billing_account.po_number present. Per-line tax changes require a schema tweak in invoice renderer — need a small migration but low risk.

support-jen: Repro payload we used (sanitized):
```json
{
  "billing_account": {
    "id": "acct-ACME-EU",
    "company_short_name": "Acme",
    "legal_entity": {
      "name": "Acme Holdings Ltd",
      "address_lines": [],
      "vat_number": "GB999999973",
      "registration_number": "12345678"
    },
    "po_number": "PO-45231",
    "country": "GB"
  },
  "line_items": [
    {"desc": "Redwood inference - monthly", "amount": 12500, "tax_rate": 20}
  ]
}
```

lisa: Customer also reported one failed invoice attempt where card declined and system generated a separate ‘payment failed’ invoice record — that landed in their AR system as a duplicate and confused reconciliation. Might be separate but worth auditing invoice->payment state transitions.

raj: Noted. I'll add an audit log check to ensure failed payment creates a flag not a new invoice record.

billing-bot: automated: invoice-generation job 1839501205 completed for acct-ACME-EU, template=v2, renderer=html2pdf-202511.

kevin: Plan: 1) Patch template header condition to include vat_number and po_number — hotfix (owner: kevin) 2) Add per-line tax columns behind feature-flag and add migration (owner: raj) 3) Small audit for duplicate invoice creation on payment failure (owner: eric) 4) Notify customer with ETA ~48h after hotfix deploy (owner: lisa).

lisa: I'll draft customer-facing message once we have hotfix PR and staging screenshot. cc @support-jen please attach before/after PDFs.

support-jen: attaching staging sample in thread (staging link): https://staging-invoices.redwood/preview/INV-98765-phantom.pdf

kevin: Pushed PR #4227 for header fix, added unit test for legal_entity rendering. Going to run canary in staging.

raj: I'll start the per-line tax flag branch and add an integration test against EU VAT examples.

eric: For the payment duplication audit — I'll run a lookup on invoices in the last 90 days for acct-ACME-EU and surface any records with multiple invoice_ids for a single charging intent.

lisa: Thanks team — priority high. Customer impact is invoicing/reconciliation hold. I'll keep the escalation ticket updated. :thumbsup:
